channel.title: Alternative Macro Signals · Blog
channel.description: Public listing at the original URL; first page of updates, not the full archive. Exact publication day omitted where unavailable.

item.title: Tracking US Electricity Price News
item.description: US electricity prices have surged since 2025, driven by AI demand and an aging grid. We show how to track electricity news in real-time.

item.title: Themes Heatmaps: Inflation Narratives at a Glance
item.description: A new tool to identify which topics are driving inflation across ten economies, in which direction, and how that has shifted over the past month.

item.title: Tweaking the NIPI parameters to improve inflation forecast accuracy
item.description: A grid search across six countries shows which NIPI parameters matter and which do not.

item.title: Working with the API: NIPI and Entropy Use Cases
item.description: A guide to the /nipi API endpoint with practical examples for querying NIPI data and its underlying Entropy components.

item.title: Can the NIPI Forecast Inflation in Europe? A Cross-Country Out-of-Sample Test
item.description: We evaluate whether the NIPIs can forecast near-term inflation in Europe.

item.title: Forecasting Global Inflation Using the Global23 NIPI Aggregate
item.description: We confront the Global23 NIPI aggregate with tough benchmarks: the OECD Economic Outlook and a standard ARMA(1,1) model.

item.title: Monitoring Global Inflation Using the Global23 NIPI Aggregate
item.description: Short-term global inflation trends can be proxied by the Global23 NIPI aggregate.

item.title: Global23 NIPI Aggregate Methodological Note
item.description: How Global23 NIPI is constructed: methodology behind the GDP-weighted news-based inflation index tracking global headline CPI pressures.

item.title: How can we track supply chain inflation in the tariff era?
item.description: Introducing the Supply Chain Inflation metric, derived from the News Volumes in the NewsBot app.

item.title: NIPI as a leading indicator for inflation expectations: new statistical evidence
item.description: We find strong evidence that the NIPI can be considered a leading indicator for inflation expectations, with significant predictive power across multiple regions.

item.title: Expanding Our Daily Inflation Databases: 8 New Countries Added to the NIPI
item.description: 23 countries are now covered in our daily inflation data.

item.title: The NIPI as an inflation leading indicator: what statistical evidence?
item.description: Putting the NIPI through the test, we find evidence it can have up to 3 months lead over official inflation releases in the US and Euro area.

item.title: Investigating The Post-COVID Inflation Dynamics - Part I: Great Volatility?
item.description: The data shows euro area inflation volatility remains puzzingly elevated at this point, when compared with the US.

item.title: Not Just One Way to Look At It: Metrics From Our Inflation Datasets
item.description: Four different ways to track and analyze inflation turning points, using the quantified signals from our datasets and powerful language models.

item.title: Three Years After: How Does the NIPI Track The Eurozone Inflation Trend?
item.description: A look at our news-based inflation diffusion index in the euro area which has still some way to go to normalize.

item.title: Comparing Car Price Dynamics in the US, China, the Euro area and Japan in 2023, using the News Balance
item.description: Car price dynamics have diverged in the economies in 2023. We illustrate how the News Balance can provide real-time international insights into sector-level inflation dynamics. "

item.title: Can Language Models Tackle Data Blind Spots? Introducing the "News Balance", Bespoke Inflation Series
item.description: Introducing our new inflation metrics. Not just a new model or dataset, but a whole new way of leveraging Language Models. "

item.title: Language Models Can Track Track Food Prices In an Easing Phase Too
item.description: Language Models trained to identify inflation relevant news continue to lead US food price inflation.

item.title: Could Japan Inflation Dynamics Be Spiraling Out of Control?
item.description: Uniquely among G7 economies, the NIPI suggests underlying inflation is not about to slow down any time soon in Japan, as core and wages pressures continue to build up.

item.title: How Does Our NIPI Track Official Inflation: US Headline CPI, Sept. 2022 Release
item.description: Our inflation diffusion index based on news articles filtered by our NLP models has continued to track remarkably well headline inflation in the US.

item.title: We Have Enhanced Our Inflation Datasets and Models to Incorporate News in Japanese!
item.description: Japanese news articles are now fully integrated in our suite of inflation monitoring data.

item.title: Loud and Clear: Combine Our NIPI (Direction) And NVI (Volume) To Spot Inflation Turning Points
item.description: We show how to combine the information from two of our timely inflation indicators to detect near-term turning points.

item.title: Can the NIPI Identify Inflation Downturns as Well as It Has Signalled Upturns?
item.description: The NIPI has been signalling near-term inflation turning points, including the deceleration in US CPI Inflation at the start of the summer 2022.

item.title: Energy Price Forecast: So Much More Than Oil Price
item.description: Energy prices dynamics can now substantially diverge from one region to the other. AMS NIPI Energy prices helps keep track of retil energy price developments in real time.

item.title: Why Inflation Forecasting is So Hard? The Role of Idiosyncratic Shocks
item.description: In the short term, inflation is a collection of largely unrelated micro shocks. Natural Language Processing can help process the huge amount of information required.

item.title: First release of the China News Inflation Pressures Indices (NIPI)
item.description: We have compiled hundreds of thousands of news articles in Chinese to build the first ever NIPI for China.

item.title: Subdued China Inflation? Our fresh Chinese NIPI indicators provide new insights
item.description: China is far from immune to the global inflation shock

item.title: Beyond base effects: Eurozone NIPIs and HICP inflation momentum
item.description: To monitor inflation momentum is tricky when seasonal adjustment is an issue. Enter the NIPIs.

item.title: The NIPI as a predictor of US inflation: Nov-2021 update
item.description: Timely catch of recent US CPI inflation turning points
